Table Games: Strategy Meets Chance

Table games bring a different rhythm. Blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and poker variants sit alongside Indian favourites such as Teen Patti and Andar Bahar.

  • Blackjack: Aim for 21 without going over. Basic strategy charts reduce the house edge. Multiple tables with different limits let beginners and higher rollers both find a seat.
  • Roulette: European versions (single zero) generally offer better odds than American. Simple even-money bets feel familiar and keep the pace relaxed.
  • Baccarat: Straightforward—bet on player, banker, or tie. Low decision-making makes it popular for longer sessions.
  • Teen Patti and Andar Bahar: These often feel the most “at home” for Indian players. Familiar rules, quick rounds, and social energy translate well online. Many versions include side bets or live-dealer options.

Table limits usually start low enough for casual play and scale up. Practice modes or lower-stakes tables help you get comfortable before risking real money.
